title: Featured Artist Agreement
summary: A guest artist records a verse or feature on another artist's song, for a fee, credit, optional points and an agreed writer share.
useWhen: Booking a feature or guest verse.
watchOuts: If the featured artist is signed to a label, the label usually must approve, sometimes with a 'courtesy of' credit and a share of royalties. Get the waiver in writing before release.
Write the composition split for the feature's lyrics into the split sheet. A paid feature fee doesn't settle writer shares unless you say so.
SoundExchange treats a featured artist as a featured performer. Agree how SoundExchange royalties are split.
Limit use of the feature to this song. Reuse in remixes or other songs should need approval.

sections.title: 1. Parties and song
sections.body: Main artist: {{main_name}} ({{main_alias}}). Featured artist: {{featured_name}} ({{featured_alias}}). Song: "{{song_title}}". Date: {{agreement_date}}.

sections.title: 2. Services
sections.body: Featured artist will write and record {{contribution}} for the Song, and deliver clean, dry vocal files by {{delivery}}.

sections.title: 3. Fee
sections.body: Main artist will pay {{fee}}: half on signing and half on delivery of the vocals.

sections.title: 4. Master royalty
sections.body: Main artist will pay Featured artist {{royalty_percent}}% of Main artist's net income from the Song's master, accounted twice a year with statements.

sections.title: 5. Ownership
sections.body: Main artist owns the master recording of the Song, including the featured performance. Featured artist keeps their writer share of {{writer_share}}% of the composition, recorded in the Song's split sheet.

sections.title: 6. Use limits
sections.body: The featured performance may be used only in the Song, including its clean, instrumental-plus-feature, sped-up and slowed versions, music videos, lyric videos and promotion, and in official remixes approved by Featured artist. Any other use needs Featured artist's written consent.

sections.title: 7. Credit and name
sections.body: Credit: "{{credit}}" on all platforms and metadata. Main artist may use Featured artist's approved name, likeness and biography to promote the Song.

sections.title: 8. Label clearance
sections.body: Featured artist is signed to {{label_name}}. This agreement is conditioned on Main artist receiving a signed waiver from {{label_name}} permitting this feature. Credit will include "courtesy of {{label_name}}" if required.

sections.title: 9. Approval
sections.body: Main artist will send Featured artist the final mix before release. Featured artist may request changes to how their performance is presented within 5 days, and approval will not be unreasonably withheld.

sections.title: 10. Promotion
sections.body: Featured artist will make at least one post about the Song on their main social channels in the release week.

sections.title: 11. Promises
sections.body: Each party promises that its contributions are original or cleared and will not infringe anyone's rights.

sections.title: 12. General terms
sections.body:
- **Whole agreement.** This document (with any attachments named in it) is the parties' entire agreement on its subject and replaces earlier discussions and drafts.
- **Changes.** It can only be changed in a writing signed by all parties.
- **Severability.** If a court finds any part unenforceable, that part is limited to the minimum extent needed and the rest stays in effect.
- **No waiver.** Not enforcing a term once is not a waiver of it later.
- **Notices.** Notices must be in writing and delivered by hand, by a recognized courier, by certified mail, or by email to the addresses in this document (or a later address a party gives in writing). Email notice is effective when sent unless the sender receives a bounce-back.
- **Governing law.** The law of the state of {{governing_state}} governs this agreement, without regard to conflict-of-law rules.
- **Counterparts and electronic signatures.** This agreement may be signed in counterparts and electronically. Each party consents to doing business electronically under the federal E-SIGN Act and the state's version of the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act (or New York's Electronic Signatures and Records Act). An electronic signature has the same effect as a handwritten one.

sections.title: Signatures
sections.body:
By signing below, each party agrees to this document.

**Main artist** — {{main_name}}

[[sig:main]]

Printed name: [[name:main]]
Date: [[date:main]]

**Featured artist** — {{featured_name}}

[[sig:featured]]

Printed name: [[name:featured]]
Date: [[date:featured]]

disclaimer: This is a starting template from the Chucksi open contract library. It is not legal advice, and using it does not create an attorney-client relationship. Laws vary by state and change over time. Have a licensed attorney in your state review it before you sign. Music rights are split between the composition (song) and the sound recording (master); royalties also depend on PRO, publisher, distributor and label agreements that this template does not change. An entertainment attorney should review deals involving advances, ownership transfers or long terms.
